label: end-of-episode unrewarded D1 (low value)
explanation: Fires only in the last ~10-20 trials of an episode (94% of activation mass in trials 90-99, none before trial 60), equivalently when the model value is lowest (94% of mass in the bottom value decile), and only on fixation-input steps: D1 (78% of mass) and GO (22%), never D2. At D1 it requires an unrewarded previous trial (zero activation when the reward input is 1). Recorded predicate: D1 after an unrewarded trial at ep_trial >= 92 (dev P 0.59, R 0.54, F1 0.57, mass recall 0.67). The broader (ep_trial >= 90) & (phase != D2) & (in_rew == 0) captures 94% of mass but at precision 0.20; adding GO steps at ep_trial >= 96 raises mass recall to 0.86 at precision 0.40. Rate and precision rise toward the final trials (precision 0.77 for ep_trial >= 96), so the unit tracks time-to-episode-end / falling value. Secondary bias toward a1 / S1-good contexts (rate 1.3x when good=S1, 0.4x when good=S2; GO activations almost all when the model picks a1), but conditioning on action did not improve F1. Uses only observed variables (episode time is implicit in the GRU state).
